primary_route_derivation: The current reader reads clave, ciclo and nivel from query parameters, appends .pdf to clave when absent, joins assets/nivel/ciclo/clave.pdf, and resolves that relative path against /pdf-reader/reader.html.
fallback_role: Legacy HTML fallback used after primary PDF-route failure; it is not the primary asset route.
rights_note: No source-book body is redistributed. The route record paraphrases only the minimum behavior needed for reproducibility and pins the observed reader bundle by hash.
